title: rangeSlider is hidden when only one value possible
body:
I have a range slider for filtering on years. I also have facetting on tags and authors. It seems that when I do a facetting on tags and authors that results in only one year, the whole slider disappear.

![2016-09-05_12h15m31](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/18244830/77f19dea-7362-11e6-83ba-7eb7ddca982f.gif)

^ Here, it's the last one, "Année".

You can see it live [here](https://pixelastic.github.io/parisweb/?q=&hPP=10&idx=parisweb&p=0&fR%5Btags%5D%5B0%5D=identit%C3%A9%20num%C3%A9rique&is_v=1)

I would suggest displaying the only possible value, in textual format instead of not displaying anything.
